items.title: Version 0.7.0-MR-Theme
items.body: New: A rebuilt look: new main menu, textbox, choices, Settings, Save/Load, pause menu, Extras and pop-ups, with six colour palettes in light or night mode; Act 8, Autumn: back to school, dates on the town map and each girl's own story (Sayori's cloudy week, Natsuki's dinner with her dad, Yuri's contest night, Monika's recital); the polycule route also gets the school finding out; A daily note from one of the girls on the main menu; The summer town map redone, a scene for every girl at every place, a second beat for each house visit, a beach shell hunt, festival stall games and real beach backgrounds; Soft background motion behind the menus (Settings › Look turns it off), pronouns and a Help guide in Settings. Improved: Every colour pair meets a proper contrast level, dialogue sits in the middle of the textbox and nothing overlaps; Phone stickers are your reply, and the phone's Match style follows your palette. Notes: This is the main release now: no more demo builds. The story ends after the first frost for now, and later updates carry on from there. Swimsuits, yukata and autumn art are stand-ins.

items.title: DDSD 0.6.1 is out: Act 7, Summer!
items.body:
The demo now plays through the whole summer. Plan it in the group chat, then walk a town map with morning and evening slots, visit each girl's home, study together, go to the beach, wear yukata at the summer festival, and find out how the exam results came out. The girls you don't spend time with notice, and they'll tell you. The beach and festival art uses stand-ins for now, real art is coming. Your saves are kept: update from the launcher. Android stays on 0.5.28 for now.
Patch notes: https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/#changelog

items.title: DDSD 0.6 is out
items.body:
Eight new textbox themes (Aurora, Matcha, Peach Fuzz, Mocha, Glacier, Dusk, Mono and Citrus) and new button styles (Pill, Glass and Flat) for the menus, the pause tiles and the back button. I also went through every theme for readability: name tags, the icons under the textbox and the Settings pages are easier to read now, especially on the dark themes. Your saves are kept: update from the launcher. Android stays on 0.5.28 for this one. If your antivirus complains about the installer, that's a false positive, and the plain game zip on the install page needs no installer at all.
Patch notes: https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/#changelog

items.title: Version 0.6.0-demo2

Improved: Readability: name tags, the icons under the textbox and Settings text now meet a proper contrast level on every theme; Dark themes: page titles are lighter, and the selected theme card no longer flashes bright pink; Settings and Extras: unselected options are darker, and the page you're on is easier to spot; Extras › Chapters scrolls, ready for more acts. items.title: DDSD 0.5.28 is out
items.body:
The big new look is here: new textbox styles (yes, real frosted glass), cloudy Sky boxes, main menu layouts and a new pause menu. Plus a lot of little comforts: Chapters and Route select, a "story so far" recap, ticks on choices you've seen, skip to the next choice, poem hints after your first clear, phone wallpapers and stickers, and nicer achievements. The launcher has a News tab now too. Your saves are kept: update from the launcher or the "Update available" button on Android.
Patch notes: https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/#changelog

items.title: Version 0.5.28-demo2
items.body: New: A whole new look (Settings › Themes): textbox styles (Rounded, Notebook, real frosted Glass, Minimal), decorations (Clouds, Sky, Petals, Sparkles), main menu layouts, a new pause menu (Esc) and icon buttons you can put in five places; Choices and History match your textbox (click a History line to rewind there), and rewind is on: the Back icon or the mouse wheel; Extras › Chapters: start again from any act you've reached, and Route select after you finish Act 6; "Story so far": a short recap when you load a save; Seen choices get a tick, and a new button skips to the next choice; Poem hints after your first clear: a heart in the colour of the girl who loves each word; Gentle content notes before Sayori's heaviest scenes (Settings › Game › Help turns them off); Phone wallpapers (any CG you've seen) and stickers you can send in chats; Achievements: hints for the secret ones, progress bars and a prettier pop-up; Autosave on every choice, F5 / F9 quick save and load, F12 for a screenshot without the textbox; Launcher 1.8: a News tab with updates, devlogs and sneak peeks, beta codes and one-click mod installs; Android: beta codes (Settings › Player › Beta). Fixed: The icons under the textbox hiding with the "On hover" position; Dark themes: the name, pronoun and look windows are easy to read; Switching back to the Original theme puts every menu back exactly the way DDLC had it.

items.title: Sneak peek: the big UI revamp!

items.title: Patch 0.5.1: Hina has a face! 🌸
items.body:
Thank you for all the reports in #bug-reports and #general. Patch 0.5.1 is out:

**New**
• Hina finally has a sprite! (art by Storm Blaze, thank you!!)
• New "Your Look" sprites: a boy and a girl in DDLC's own style (by Storm Blaze and u/shidodraws), with a picker that shows pictures in Settings

**How to update:** Windows: open the DDSD launcher and press **Update**. Android: tap **Update available** on the main menu. Your saves are kept.
Download / changelog: https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/

items.title: Demo 2 is out! 🌸 Acts 1 to 6, on Windows AND Android
items.body:
The whole common route is playable now: from your first day in the club all the way to the festival fireworks. Who will you watch them with?

**Download (free):** https://github.com/Aoi-doki/ddsd-releases/releases/latest
**How to install (with an Android guide):** https://aoi-doki.github.io/ddsd/install.html

**Windows:** grab `DDSD-Setup.exe`. It installs the game, finds your DDLC files, and keeps everything updated. (If Windows says "protected your PC": More info → Run anyway.)
**Android:** grab `DDSD.apk`. On first launch tap **PC** and pick the `ddlc-win.zip` you downloaded from ddlc.moe. The app updates itself from now on.
**Mac / Linux:** `ddsd-game.zip`, then copy DDLC's audio/fonts/images.rpa into its game folder.

**New in Demo 2**
• Act 5 (Festival Prep) and Act 6 (The Festival), and a new member: Hina
• You're in the club photo now: pick your look!
• Monika's own piano piece, real lighting, a bigger phone with chat bubbles in each girl's colour
• Text size slider, choice button styles, and a LOT of playtester fixes. Thank you all ♥

You need the original DDLC (free at ddlc.moe), and please finish it first. Work in progress: everything is subject to change. Bugs → #bug-reports!
